column2: [intro]
On parallel paths, our destinies crossed
You and me, strangers destined to love
But our lives are different, our worlds apart
And despite this distance, our hearts have resonated
On the parallel paths, our souls search
Through the labyrinths, our feelings are nourished
Despite the obstacles, our bonds strengthen
On the parallel paths, our loves intertwine
Our eyes met, a spark was born
In a fleeting moment, a connection was made
But the constraints of time, the choices to be made
Separated us, leaving our love in suspense
On the parallel paths, our souls search
Through the labyrinths, our feelings are nourished
Despite the obstacles, our bonds strengthen
On the parallel paths, our loves intertwine
[ solo ]
The days pass and our paths drift further apart
But our love persists, it burns in me like a wild fire
Maybe one day, our paths will finally converge
And we will be able to live our love, without any more constraints
[outro]
